entries.08ce096e6af65f34: Car and Motorcycle Goods Sales Business
entries.0dddc8a026760d00: 2rinkan Yellow Hat Co., Ltd. engages in retail sales of motorcycle accessories and related products at its '2rinkan' stores, Baiku-kan Yellow Hat Co., Ltd. engages in retail and wholesale sales of motorcycles and motorcycle accessories and related products at its 'Baiku-kan' stores, and Wise Road Yellow Hat Co., Ltd. engages in retail sales of motorcycles and motorcycle accessories and related products at its 'Wise Road' stores. The number of stores at the end of March 2026 was 65 for 2rinkan, 78 for Baiku-kan (including Kawasaki Plaza) and 28 for Wise Road. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, 'Motorcycle Accessories' in revenue by product category (consolidated total) was ¥13,987 million (8.2% of total).
entries.43ad3228b4ac7e4d: Sales Subsidiaries, Affiliates and Group Companies
entries.4d8b68e0f0bfb064: This is the business in which the company wholesales car products, motorcycle products and others to sales subsidiaries, affiliated companies and group companies, and also sells at retail through sales subsidiaries, affiliated companies and Web sites. Joyful Co., Ltd. manufactures and wholesales car products, motorcycle products and others. Net sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥165,486 million (111.6% of the same period of the previous year, an increase of ¥17,199 million), which is among the larger reportable segments. Segment profit (a figure based on operating profit in the consolidated statement of income) was ¥13,680 million (97.3% of the same period, a decrease of ¥376 million). In net sales by product category (consolidated total), tires and wheels were the largest at ¥52,321 million (30.5% of the total), and labor charges were ¥25,266 million (14.8%). Labor charges have been shown separately from the fiscal year ended March 2026 because their amount became more significant. The number of stores as of the end of March 2026 was 936 in total: 765 Yellow Hat stores, 65 2Rinkan stores, 78 Bike-kan stores (including Kawasaki Plaza) and 28 Y's Road stores. In addition, there are 10 vehicle inspection centers, 12 coin-operated car washes and 101 Niconico Rent-a-Car locations.
entries.51472d76b6f12e2b: Sales subsidiaries, affiliated companies, group companies and others that operate "Yellow Hat" and "Kakuyasu Tire Tread" stores sell car products and other goods at retail.
entries.51bee1a51e5d4493: In this business, the company wholesales automotive supplies, two-wheeled vehicle supplies and other products to sales subsidiaries, affiliates, group companies and others, and also conducts retail sales through sales subsidiaries and affiliates and on Web sites.
entries.82f3096c70c09eef: No customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue.
entries.8e733cf60c770c4f: The company leases buildings and facilities to sales subsidiaries, affiliates and group companies. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥5,793 million (100.2% year on year, an increase of ¥13 million), and segment profit (based on operating profit in the consolidated statement of income) was ¥1,406 million (100.9% year on year, an increase of ¥12 million).
entries.9fefa828facfe7a7: A company that supplies car products and motorcycle products wholesale to sales subsidiaries and group companies, and sells them to general customers at stores such as "Yellow Hat".

entries.dbd73478d4c3a136: Sales subsidiaries, affiliated companies and group companies that operate "Yellow Hat" and "Kakuyasu Tire Tread" stores carry out retail sales of car products and others. The number of Yellow Hat stores (including Kakuyasu Tire Tread stores) was 765 as of the end of March 2026. This is an increase of 14 stores from 751 stores as of the end of March 2025; during the 1 year of the fiscal year ended March 2026, 20 stores were opened and 6 stores were closed.
